_comment: The showcase: invented characters (generated, never real people) and the takes rendered with them. Run `openfield showcase --dry-run` to see the plan, then `openfield showcase` against a real backend. The re-shoot source at showcase/assets/source.mp4 is the showcase's own dance-source take (an invented dancer on a rooftop, rendered with LTX 2.5), so no real person's footage ships with the repo; put your own clip there to re-shoot yourself.
